ov: بيت الحيوان (الإنجليزية: Animal House) هو فيلم كوميدي أمريكي من إخراج جون لانديس وتأليف هارولد راميس، دوغلاس كيني وكريس ميلر ومن بطولة جون بيلوشي، بيتر ريجرت، تيم ماثيسون، جون فيرنون وفيرنا بلوم، صدر الفيلم في 28 يوليو 1978.
plotEn:
In 1962, Faber College freshmen Larry Kroger and Kent Dorfman are seeking to join a fraternity. Unwelcome at the exclusive Omega Theta Pi, the two visit the decrepit Delta Tau Chi house next door. Kent believes that Delta will have to accept him as a "legacy" since his brother was a member. They meet John ("Bluto") Blutarsky, chapter president Robert ("Hoov") Hoover, charismatic ladies' man Eric ("Otter") Stratton, Daniel Simpson ("D-Day") Day, suave Donald ("Boon") Schoenstein and Boon's exasperated girlfriend Katy. Larry and Kent are accepted as pledges and given the fraternity names "Pinto" and "Flounder", respectively. Meanwhile, Omega pledge Chip Diller is given a paddling as part of his initiation.
Delta house is on probation due to their shenanigans and overall poor academic scores. Wishing to remove the fraternity from Faber's campus, Dean Vernon Wormer places the Deltas on "double secret probation" and directs Greg Marmalard, the Omega president, to get fellow Omega and ROTC Cadet Commander Douglas C. Neidermeyer to find a reason to revoke Delta's charter. Various Delta misadventures ensue, including the accidental death of Neidermeyer's horse during a retaliatory prank following the abuse cadet Flounder receives from Neidermeyer.
